# TrendyJoes — private source migration

This repository is exclusively for TrendyJoes Design Works / Universal Custom Design & 3D Product Studio. It is separate from Minus99x/Omegavault.

The authorized offline source baseline is v0.30.172, archive SHA-256 `7efe931bf9c26ea132fa8fc046950f253a6541957c9a8bb95a196a586b22fd02` (626 files). The original source and historical Git bundles remain preserved in ChatGPT Library `/TrendyJoes Night Watch/`.

Migration is not complete until all files are copied and checked against the archive manifest. The default branch is an administrative stable baseline. Engineering changes belong on an isolated development branch.

**No Shopify writes, deployment, checkout, payment, production changes, or authorization are implied by this repository.**
